definitions: A chart used to measure visual acuity, typically consisting of rows of letters, numbers, or symbols that decrease in size.
An eye chart, such as a Snellen chart, used by ophthalmologists and optometrists to test a person's eyesight.
examples: The optometrist asked me to read the smallest line on the vision chart.
Many vision charts use the Snellen design.
He squinted at the vision chart, trying to make out the letters.
